completion:
# Instructions for accurately documenting industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2. Analyse the monitored emissions.
3. Review the air pollution laws and regulations.
4. Identify potential issues and areas of non-compliance.
5. Incorporate all data and information into the report.
6. Keep the report up to date and accurate.
7. Use the report to make informed decisions to address any polluting issues.
8. Ensure the report is used as a tool for efficient and cost-effective pollution prevention.
9. Use the report as a source of input for further actions to reduce pollution.
10. Share the report and any successes and lessons learned with stakeholders to build trust and collaboration.
